:[A cross-section of a portion of the Earth is seen from a distance, with four layers shown. On the surface is a large device resembling a typical fishing-rod-style cat toy, but so large that the people next to it appear as mere specks. Two helicopters are in the air around it. The helicopters are probably included to offer some sense of scale.  A voice comes from the specks to the left of the device.]
:Voice 1: The key to exposing new geologic layers is understanding the three forces driving plate movement: slab pull, ridge push, and taunting.

:[The giant fishing rod starts being wiggled by a hydraulic activator to make the toy dance around in the air. Another voice comes from the left of the first voice.]
:Voice 2: Taunting? What do--
:Voice 1: '''''Initiate thrust fault pattern!'''''

:[The toy continues to wiggle around in the air. A diagonal fault starts to appear underground.]
:Sound effect: RUMBLE

:[The toy continues to wiggle around in the air. The land at the right thrusts itself above the rest of the land.]
:Sound effect: LUNGE!
